title: AI4IA official MCP server catalog
description: Curated 'official' MCP servers exposed and governed through the shared active APIM front door (infra/modules/mcpgateway.bicep), gated on an APIM subscription key. Source of truth consumed by Bicep (provisions one APIM MCP server per entry) and projected into the packaged runtime catalog by scripts/gen-mcp-catalog.py.

name.description: Stable slug used as the APIM resource name and route prefix (https://<mcp-apim>/<name>/mcp). Lowercase letter-led alphanumeric + hyphens, 2-40 chars.

upstreamUrl.description: Full HTTPS Streamable-HTTP MCP endpoint of the upstream server; APIM routes to it as the backend target. The upstream must speak MCP version 2025-06-18 or later.

upstreamAuthMode.description: How APIM authenticates OUTBOUND to the upstream server. 'none' = transparent passthrough; 'managed_identity' = inject the MCP APIM system-assigned identity as a bearer token (requires upstreamMiResource). Note: inbound auth from the app to APIM is always the APIM subscription key, independent of this field.

upstreamMiResource.description: AAD resource / audience URI used to acquire the managed-identity token (e.g. an Entra App ID URI for an Azure-hosted upstream). Required when upstreamAuthMode == 'managed_identity'.

upstreamHeaders.description: Optional static request headers APIM injects OUTBOUND to the upstream on every call (set-header, override), layered on top of any managed-identity bearer. Values are non-secret, XML-safe constants baked into the policy; secrets belong in managed identity or named values. Example (Foundry toolbox): { "Foundry-Features": "Toolboxes=V1Preview" }.

upstreamQueryParams.description: Optional static query parameters APIM injects OUTBOUND to the upstream on every call (set-query-parameter, override). Example (Foundry toolbox): { "api-version": "v1" }.

foundryToolbox.description: When true, this entry is an Azure AI Foundry toolbox and its `upstreamUrl` is NOT hardcoded here: main.bicep computes it from the deployed primary project endpoint as `<projectEndpoint>/toolboxes/<name>/mcp`, so the catalog stays portable across subscriptions/tenants/environments. Omit `upstreamUrl` when this is true.
